2 شوّههُ , (S, K,) inf. n. تَشْوِيهٌ, (TA,) He (God) rendered foul, unseemly, or ugly, his face: (S, K, TA:) and it, i. e. the conformation of the face. (TA, from a verse of El-Hotei-ah.) And شَوَّهْتُ الوُجُوهَ I rendered foul, unseemly, or ugly, the faces. (Msb.) ―
-b2- And شَوَّهَ ٱللّٰهُ حُلُوقَكُمْ God rendered, or may God render, wide your throats, or fauces. (TA.) ―
-b3- لَا تُشَوِّهْ عَلَىَّ: see 1, latter half. ―
-b4- شوّه بِيَدِهِ He (a man) made a sign with his arm, or hand. (JK.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
